_comment: Tier-2 for febio::damage#0, and a NARROWING of it. The shipped deck ramps to three different amplitudes and cannot answer a two-identical-cycle question, so the fixture substitutes the 0 -> A -> 0 -> A history the claim prescribes and sweeps Dmax. Executed: the second cycle repeats the first to within a fraction of a percent at Dmax = 0, 0.3 AND 0.6, and is markedly softer only at 0.9. The claim said the peaks are "bit-identical" at 0 and 0.3 and that 0.6 AND 0.9 soften — the saturated peaks agree closely but not bit for bit, and 0.6 is on the saturated side. The fixture asserts the STRUCTURE (a saturated set, a softening set, and the saturated caps all below the softening ones) and deliberately does not pin the boundary, which is deck-dependent. Executed 2026-08-06 on FEBio 4.12.0.86045466d (source build, USE_MKL=OFF). MUTATION CONTROL (2026-08-07): T2_MUTATE=1 neutralises the L.swap / L.drop edits this fixture uses to turn a correct deck into a broken one, so every deck it builds is the correct one and the pitfall is never triggered. Unmutated the fixture still PASSES; mutated it FAILS because the expectation 'damage_cycles=reproduced_with_correction' is no longer printed and the forbidden token 'not_reproduced' appears. Re-verify with `cd <fixture dir> && T2_MUTATE=1 ~/Schreibtisch/open-fem-agent/.venv/bin/python source.py` (the mutation branch lives in source.py, so the proof is one command and needs no external harness).
